descriptionChirho: To be guilty, become guilty, or incur guilt before God or in a legal/cultic sense (Qal stem, all inflections including infinitive absolute as intensifier).
To recognize and confess one's guilt, acknowledging culpability as a step toward repentance (Qal with reflexive/cognitive nuance).
To pronounce someone guilty, to condemn or hold liable (Hifil causative stem).
To be made desolate or to suffer the consequences of guilt, bearing punishment (Nifal passive/reflexive stem).
